source_evidence: The SEC makes these documents publicly available without charge on its EDGAR website.
answer: To research a public company, you can use EDGAR to find its filings with the SEC at no charge. A Form 10-K gives audited annual financial statements and a discussion of business results. A Form 10-Q covers unaudited financial statements and business information for each of the first three fiscal quarters. A Form 8-K reports major events shareholders should know about. These filings offer different kinds of information, so choose the report that matches what you want to learn.
